about_the_game:
• About the game

    • Hamster Hustle is a fast-paced, online multiplayer party game that supports up to 12 players per match. Built with a focus on player interaction and replayability, it offers a lighthearted blend of strategy, movement, and chaos—perfect for game nights, streaming, and casual competition.

    Each round begins with one player randomly selected as “it.” The objective? Tag another player to pass it on and keep your score low, because the longer you’re tagged, the higher your time. Use sprinting, pushing, and quick thinking to avoid becoming the next target. The player with the least time tagged wins the game. With a range of vibrant maps, customizable game modes, and support for both public and private lobbies, Hamster Hustle is designed to bring people together. Features like proximity voice chat and Steam friend integration make it easy to stay connected and keep the laughs going. Whether you're competing with friends or hopping into quick matches, Hamster Hustle delivers quick, memorable rounds and a cozy visual style that invites players back for "just one more game."

  • Key Features

    • Up to 12-player online multiplayer

    • Tag-based gameplay with simple but strategic mechanics

    • Built-in proximity chat and Steam friend list support

    • In-game skin customization, a wide variety of emotes, and flashy VFX

    • Variety of hand-crafted maps from spacious arenas to fast-paced close-quarters

    • Flexible lobby system with customizable game modes

    • Designed to create meaningful, social, and memorable gameplay moments

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600x or Intel i5-9600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
